_meta.note: Wiki-harvested seed shard. Values are verbatim from the DDO wiki; `provenance` records whether the wiki stated the value, fell back to a template default, or is silent. Only `stated` is solver-eligible.
_meta.snapshots_note: Rendered-tooltip snapshots keyed by case-normalized template invocation. The tooltip is a pure function of the invocation, so this is keyed by invocation rather than by item. Riposte renders TWO dialects: Arabic `{{Riposte|N}}` grants +N to both halves, while Roman `{{Riposte|R}}` grants R/2 rounded UP to Armor Class and R/2 rounded DOWN to the saves — so the two halves differ on every odd numeral.
